title: Atmospheric Tornado
subtitle: Rankine Combined Vortex Dynamics & Updraft Physics
description: Severe mesocyclone tornadic vortex simulation modeling hyperbolic funnel cone boundary expansion, Rankine tangential velocity shear, and particle suction updraft.
mathNotation: v_\theta(r) = \begin{cases} \omega r & r \le R_c \\ \frac{\Gamma}{2\pi r} & r > R_c \end{cases}, \quad R(z) = R_0 + \alpha z^{2.2}, \quad v_z(z) = v_0 \left(1 + \beta z\right)
formulaCompact: v_theta = speed / (0.3 + r*0.7),  R_funnel = 20 + z^2.2 * 170,  sway = sin(1.5t + 3z)*40z
